title: Official blog fixture replay stage 18
summary: This iteration adds a local fixture-backed replay for the official-blog workflow. The replay exercises OpenAI and Anthropic feed excerpts through preview parsing, intake, AI review packet creation, decision normalization, authoring brief generation, completed human templates, reviewed-authoring validation, and knowledge draft creation without live network access.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "official blog runbook replay fixtures" tests/official-blog-knowledge.test.js

lessons.lesson: The runbook needs a fixture replay so future changes can prove the full path without relying on live OpenAI or Anthropic feeds.
lessons.evidence: Stage 18 adds `tests/fixtures/official-blog-runbook-replay/` and a deterministic replay test that produces two accepted draft records and holds a customer-framed item at manual review.
lessons.recommended_action: Run the replay test whenever changing official-blog workflow docs, admission behavior, or authoring contracts.

lessons.lesson: Preview-only triage should be tested with content that has technical terms outside the opening preview.
lessons.evidence: The Anthropic regional partnership fixture contains technical terms only after the preview limit and remains excluded, proving full article body text is not used for first-pass admission.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep hidden-body fixtures in the replay when expanding admission criteria.

suggestions.issue: The operator still has to run each official-blog workflow command manually.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 18 validates the flow through in-process functions and fixture inputs but does not add a single orchestration command.
suggestions.suggestion: Consider an explicit orchestrator command only after the manual checkpoint semantics are stable.
suggestions.expected_benefit: A future orchestrator could reduce operator error while preserving dry-run and human-review checkpoints.
suggestions.promotion_path: Future project iteration with CLI tests and no public artifact writes.
validation_evidence: official blog runbook replay fixtures exercise local OpenAI and Anthropic flow

followups.action: Consider a single official-blog workflow orchestrator command after the manual checkpoint rules are stable.
